name: Captcha Keypad
description: On-screen numeric keypad CAPTCHA: the visitor clicks a short displayed code key-by-key instead of typing distorted text. Privacy-friendly, no third-party service.
project_description: Captcha Keypad is a self-contained CAPTCHA challenge that replaces distorted text with an on-screen numeric keypad. The visitor is shown a short numeric code (1–16 digits, default set from config) and must click it key-by-key on the keypad; typing the code is rejected. The buttons can be shuffled on every page load. Nothing is sent to a third-party service, so it is a privacy-friendly alternative to reCAPTCHA. It works in two modes: standalone, where hook_form_alter() adds the keypad to a configured list of core forms (user register/login/login-block/password, contact, comment, forum, node forms); or, when the contrib CAPTCHA module is installed, as a CAPTCHA challenge type named "Keypad" placed via CAPTCHA points. Because the keypad must be clicked, it is not suitable as the only challenge on forms that must be usable by keyboard-only or screen-reader users. Configuration lives at /admin/config/system/captcha_keypad and is gated by the 'administer captcha keypad' permission; user 1 and holders of that permission can optionally be exempted.
